meta.title: Free SaaS product directory and verified MRR leaderboard
meta.description: Discover independent SaaS products or list your SaaS for free. Get a public product page and compare MRR verified through read-only payment connections.
meta.revenueDescription: Independent SaaS products ranked by the revenue their payment provider verifies for the last {window}, one-time purchases included.
meta.revenueDescriptionAll: Independent SaaS products ranked by the revenue their payment provider verifies since their first payment, one-time purchases included.

founder.lead: Every SaaS is welcome, verified or not. You get a public page with a link to your site, and other users can find you and write to you. Connecting your payment provider is optional and puts you on the leaderboard.
founder.gainPage: A public page for your product
founder.gainLink: A dofollow link to your website once you verify revenue
founder.gainViews: Page views and messages from other users
founder.gainLeaderboard: A place on the leaderboard, if you connect your revenue
founder.noPayment: No payment details and no revenue check needed.

explore.leaderboardDescription: Ranked by monthly recurring revenue, verified through each product's payment provider.
explore.revenueDescription: Ranked by revenue in the last {window}, one-time purchases included, verified through each product's payment provider.
explore.revenueDescriptionAll: Ranked by revenue since the first payment, one-time purchases included, verified through each product's payment provider.
explore.browseDescription: Every product listed here, A to Z, including those that keep revenue private.
explore.newestDescription: The latest products to join, newest first.
explore.noMatchesHint: Try another category, technology or search term.
explore.emptyMrr: Products appear here once their founder connects a payment provider and shares verified MRR.
explore.emptyRevenue: Products appear here once their founder connects a payment provider and shares verified revenue.
explore.beFirst: Be the first to list a product.
explore.demoBody: Made-up examples that show what a listing looks like. They are never ranked and leave as real products join.
explore.footnoteMrr: MRR is read from each product's subscriptions through a read-only key to its payment provider and refreshed every hour.
explore.footnoteRevenue: Revenue is every payment a product received, one-time purchases included, after refunds and without tax. It is read through a read-only key to the product's payment provider and refreshed every day.
explore.footnoteRules: Figures older than seven days are not ranked. Equal amounts are ordered by revenue of all time, then by the date the product was listed.
